notes.title: Sign up for the playtest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934256/d4d1a518f8aafdd1e0ab742ccbd3764773c536d4.png[/img]

[h1]About the playtest[/h1]
We're getting close to releasing a [b]demo[/b], but first we would appreciate help from players on any potential bugs missed during closed testing. The playtest will be a short experience (~30min) to ensure we're focusing on the most important aspects for player experience.

[h1]Sign Up![/h1]
Simply click on the [b]Request Access[/b] button on the steam page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1358660/ReAwaken/

[h1]Dates[/h1]
We'll start giving player's access on [b]August 7th[/b] and close the playtest [b]August 27th[/b].

[h1]Content[/h1]
- 1 area with various levels having a Good and Evil version
- 24 Upgrades & Downgrades to choose from during your runs
- 15 Attacks & Special abilities
- 6 Permanent upgrades to unlock and equip
- 9 Enemies
- 1 Shadowy boss battle

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
With your feedback we know the game is going to [i]awaken[/i] to it's fullest potential! We appreciate any support as we prepare to make the game as engaging and enjoyable as possible!
